newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firm, Pliva dominates trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firm, Pliva dominates trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly higher in brisk trade on Wednesday, with drugs concern Pliva accounting for two-thirds of the transactions.
* Seven of 13 active issues rose, two fell and four were flat.
* Volume fell to 20,919 from 23,228 units and turnover to 13.3 million kuna from 19.9 million on Tuesday.
* Biggest gainer chocolate maker Kras added 23 kuna or 5.5 percent to 440, on volume of 1,188 shares.
* Bigger decliner Varazdinska Banka lost seven kuna or 3.3 percent to 207 with 676 shares sold.
* Most active issue Pliva rose 15 kuna to 495 kuna, selling 14,107 shares.
